## What's Changed

**OpenCode 2 only.** The plugin API changed between OpenCode 1 and 2, and a 1.x release cannot load under OpenCode 1. Stay on `opencode-search@0.0.9` for OpenCode 1. That is the last release for that line and will not be updated.

### Ported to the OpenCode 2 plugin API

- Moved to `@opencode/plugin`, replacing the preview `@opencode-ai/plugin/v2`
- `Tool.DynamicDefinition` became `Tool.Info`, `jsonSchema` became `input`
- Tool names use underscores (`brave_search`), matching OpenCode's own built-ins
- Installing under OpenCode 1 fails with a message naming the version to pin

### New search tools

- `brave_search`: Brave Search, the most reliable general web provider here
- `gnews_search`: Google News RSS for recent coverage
- `rfc_search`: IETF RFCs by number (`9421`, `RFC9421`) or title
- `w3c_search`: W3C specifications by title
- `whatwg_search`: WHATWG living standards

### Removed

- `ggl_search`: Google sends no results to a non-browser client. Verified against seven browser TLS fingerprints, HTTP/2, cookie warm-up and four regional domains
- `mojeek_search`: Mojeek's robots.txt disallows `/search` and their terms prohibit automated access
- `standard_search`: the appview has no DNS record and standard.site publishes no replacement

See [REMOVED.md](https://github.com/whaaaley/opencode-search/blob/main/REMOVED.md) for what was tested in each case.

## What's Changed

- Upgraded DDG search to use POST + form params (like ddgr) and return structured results (title, URL, abstract) instead of a raw text blob
- Added Google search tool (`ggl-search`) with cookie replay approach derived from googler
- Updated renderers for structured DDG and Google result formatting
- Added Google search tests and updated DDG search tests

## What's Changed

- Internal refactor: remove unused default from `Result` type in `safe.ts`

## What's Changed

- Expose `sort` arg on `bsky-search` tool
- Export item types directly from providers
- Split `formatDate` into `formatDate` and `formatDateTime`
- Simplify cache using `safe` and `safeAsync`
- Refactor `safeAsync` destructuring across all search tools
- Flatten `src/utils` into `src` root

## What's Changed

- Document `mdn-search` tool in README
- Add hero image to README
